news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems (NASDAQ: RPID) details losses and cash use in Q2 2026
Rapid Micro Biosystems reports Q2 2026 revenue $8.1M, record gross margin 15%
Rapid Micro Biosystems, Inc. (RPID) Reports Q2 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports 11% Q2 Revenue Growth
Rapid Micro Biosystems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 11% year-over-year to $8.1 million, with consumables revenue up more than 20% and gross margin improving to a record 15% from 4% a year earlier, though net loss widened to $12.9 million. The company reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $37-41 million and guided Q3 2026 revenue of at least $9.5 million with at least 7 new system placements.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Marks 200th Growth Direct System Placement
news.summary: Alongside Q2 earnings, the company announced it placed its 200th Growth Direct system globally, with four placements and nine validations completed during the quarter, underscoring growing commercial adoption of its automated microbial detection platform.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: The company granted 90,000 RSUs and a non-qualified option to purchase 170,000 shares (exercise price $2.12) as a material inducement to a new employee, issued under its Inducement Plan per Nasdaq Rule 5635(c)(4).

news.headline: Director Richard S. Kollender exercises stock options for 3,508 shares
news.summary: RPID director Richard S. Kollender exercised options for 3,508 Class A shares at a $0.75 exercise price, a routine insider transaction.

news.headline: Rapid Micro Biosystems to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on August 7, 2026
news.summary: The company confirmed it would release Q2 2026 results before market open on August 7, 2026, with a management webcast/conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET the same day.

news.headline: President and CEO Robert G. Spignesi Jr. exercises stock option
news.summary: CEO Robert Spignesi exercised a fully vested option for 1,402 Class A shares at $0.75 per share, a routine transaction ahead of the option's August 11, 2026 expiration.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report expected roughly three months after Q2, per the company's standard reporting cadence. Management guided Q3 2026 revenue of at least $9.5 million with at least 7 Growth Direct system placements.

catalysts.label: 10 millionth Growth Direct consumable kit shipment
catalysts.detail: On the Q2 2026 earnings call, management said it expects to ship its 10 millionth Growth Direct consumable kit during Q3 2026, a milestone reflecting growing routine use of the installed base.

catalysts.label: Full-year 2026 guidance: $37-41M revenue, 30-38 system placements
catalysts.detail: Reaffirmed at Q2 2026 earnings: total revenue guidance of $37.0-$41.0 million, 30-38 Growth Direct system placements, at least 27 system validations (raised from 25 previously), and gross margin of approximately 20%, with Q4 gross margin expected to reach the mid-to-high 20% range.

catalysts.label: MilliporeSigma distribution partnership
catalysts.detail: Ongoing distribution agreement with MilliporeSigma intended to accelerate multi-system rollouts and broaden commercial reach for the Growth Direct platform.

pulse: Rapid Micro Biosystems reported Q2 2026 revenue of $8.1 million (up 11% year-over-year), with record consumables growth and gross margin improving to 15% from 4% a year ago, while placing its 200th Growth Direct system globally and reaffirming full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $37-41 million. The company guided Q3 2026 revenue of at least $9.5 million with at least 7 new system placements and flagged a cost-efficiency program targeting roughly $1 million in savings in 2026 and $3 million annually from 2027, supporting a path to positive cash flow by end of 2028. Aside from routine insider option exercises and a new-hire inducement grant, news flow was otherwise quiet ahead of the earnings release.
